children.description:
A list with message items. If only one item is provided, the initial page will be the details page for the item.

* __Note:__ Although this prop accepts all HTML Elements, it is strongly recommended that you only use `Message` in order to preserve the intended design.

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

groupItems.description: Defines whether the messages are grouped or not.

onItemSelect.description: Event is fired when the details of a message are shown.

showDetailsPageHeader.description: Defines whether the header of the details page will be shown.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.
